Why every great fortune starts with a setback.

Kevin explains that if you pick ten of the most successful founders, such as the people behind Honda, Toyota, Kraft, Federal Express and UPS, each faced several catastrophes and came close to bankruptcy.

Out of that pressure came the idea that built their businesses. He closes with a Napoleon Hill phrase: in every adversity are the seeds of a greater benefit.

Which setback in your own life turned out to be a turning point?
